newsitem.title: UK: NWE high sulphur fuel oil softens as crude tumbles.
newsitem.headline: NWE high sulphur fuel oil softens as crude tumbles.

text.p: NWE high sulphur fuel oil cargo prices eased back on Thursday as crude oil futures fell sharply, traders said.
High sulphur barges changed hands in very volatile business between $95 and $100 a tonne fob ARA. Dealers said that by the end of the day's business the bid/offer range was around $95/$96.
Cargoes were softer and although one player in Scotland was seeking material it was considered above market because of the unusual quality specifications.

Other utilities were heard sitting back from the market but were expected to be somewhere in the range of $92/$93 cif NWE. Given the continued overhang of supply, dealers saw little room for upwards movement.
Low sulphur fuel oil markets were again becalmed, with only a little potential interest seen to cover Italian requirements, and small pockets of demand into France.
But prices were weaker as crude oil futures lost ground and amid a continuation of the recent ample supply situation.
